# <span id="aanchor387"></span> Formula Validation and Error Messages

A formula expression consisting of three statements cannot be saved to the database unless the syntax is correct and all member relationships are correct. Otherwise, the Calculated Meter Rollup service cannot perform correctly.

### Syntax Validation

Syntactical validation is triggered from the Calculated Meter Editor by:

- Clicking the **Validate** button in an edit form
- Clicking the **Apply** button in an edit form
- Saving data in the Calculated Meter Editor

In the first two events, only the current statement being edited is validated. When saving the edit session and exiting the Calculated Meter Editor, IF, DO, and ELSE DO statements are validated together as an expression.

All validations are syntactical only and will not validate whether the mathematical expression is a valid operation. If an expression leads to an invalid operation, the Calculated Meter Rollup service will log an exception message when it evaluates the expression for processing. See: <a href="#Exceptions" class="notelink" style="color: #47bfef;">Formula Exception Messages</a>

When the validation is complete, a Validation Results window will display. If there are any errors, they will be listed here. All errors must be resolved before the statement can be saved.

The following error messages can be generated during syntax validation.

| Error Message | Description/Notes |
|:---|:---|
| The left/right side of the statement should not be empty. Please provide information for the left/right side. | IF statement cannot be populated only on one side (IF statement only). |
| Statement must contain at least one location or meter. | IF statement only |
| The left/right side of the statement did not end properly. Please complete the left/right side. | Each side must end with either a member, a constant, or closing parenthesis (IF statement only). |
| Statement did not end properly. Please complete the statement. | Statement must end with either a member, a constant, or closing parenthesis (DO and ELSE DO statements only). |
| \<Meter/Location\> is not a member of the calculated meter. | This error occurs when a member is removed from the calculated meter, either by editing in the Relationship tab or by deleting it from FLOWCAL. The calculated meter edit session following the removal cannot be saved until the formulas are edited to exclude the removed member. |
| If and Do statements should not be empty simultaneously. | This error occurs when an ELSE DO statement is provided but IF and DO statements are not. |
| Do and Else Do statements should not be empty simultaneously. | This error occurs when IF statement is provided but DO and ELSE DO statements are not. |
| Statement guarantees a division by zero. Please remove division by zero. | \- |
| Parser experienced an error when processing “\<insert\>". | \- |
| “\<insert\>” is an invalid statement component. | \- |
| Unknown compiler error. | \- |
| Parenthetical structure is invalid. Please review the opening and closing parentheses. | DO and ELSE DO statements only |
| Left/Right Side - Parenthetical structure is invalid. Please review the opening and closing parentheses. | IF statement only |
| Statement is invalid. Please review for mathematical validity. | \- |
| Statement includes invalid arithmetic operation. Please review for mathematical validity. | \- |
| Parser does not recognize "\<insert\>". | \- |

<span id="Exceptions"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Exceptions">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Formula Exception Messages</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Exceptions">

If the Calculated Meter Rollup service evaluates a formula statement and fails to produce a valid result, an exception message will be logged to the service log file for the measurement hour.

Evaluation of the IF statement takes place for each hour of the calculated meter, but all hours for an entire day or an entire month could possibly have same result, depending on the resolution of the IF statement configured on the Formulas tab. When the evaluation of the IF statement does not yield a valid value and the IF statement cannot be determined to be true or false, an exception message is logged for all applicable hours per the statement resolution.

Evaluation of the DO or ELSE DO statement takes place for each of the summed values for each hour of the calculated meter. Although an invalid result might be produced for any and all of the summed values, an exception message is logged only if the adjusted total volume (FC_FFMTR_HOURLY.adjusted_total_volume) and the adjusted total energy (FC_FFMTR_HOURLY.adjusted_total_energy) result in an invalid value. Results for other summed values are irrelevant to the exception logging.

An invalid result, or a null value, is different from a blank statement. Exception messages are not logged for blank statements.

This could happen for a variety of reasons, including but not limited to:

- **Unintended division by zero**

**For example:** 1 / (METER1 - METER1) will be evaluated as Not a Number, regardless of the METER1 value. Another example is 1 / (METER1 - METER2) where METER1 and METER2 happen to have the same values.

- **Unintended division by null**

**For example:** 1 / METER1 will be evaluated to be null when METER1 has no value.

The Calculated Meter Rollup service currently supports three exception messages:

| Exception Message | Description/Notes |
|:---|:---|
| 1201 CV – Evaluation failed for the IF statement of the calculated meter | The evaluation of the IF statement fails to produce a valid value for any reason and the evaluation result is null. All summed values of the final form hourly record for the calculated meter being processed will be null. This message is logged for each hour and each calculated meter with the error. |
| 1202 CV – Evaluation failed for the DO statement of the calculated meter | The IF statement is true and the evaluation of the DO statement fails to produce a valid value for adjusted total volume and adjusted total energy for any reason and they are both null. This message is logged for each hour and each calculated meter with these results. |
| 1203 CV – Evaluation failed for the ELSE DO statement of the calculated meter | The IF statement is false and the evaluation of the ELSE DO statement fails to produce a valid value for adjusted total volume and adjusted total energy for any reason and they are both null. This message is logged for each hour and each calculated meter with these results. |

</div>
